reason: Vertical collision on the word 'gaming': Trivelta is a B2B iGaming/gambling platform vendor (sportsbook, casino aggregation, PAM, poker for operators; trivelta.com/about-us), not a funded US PC/console game studio entering full production — there is no game, no publisher milestone, no Steam page, so Ben's EDP (milestone confidence against a publisher-fixed date) does not exist here; it is also too large and too built-out for a fractional engagement (its own About page claims 230+ engineers across 5 offices in Boston, Atlanta, Monterrey, Barcelona and Bangalore, 2.4M+ players, 6,000+ transactions/sec), and its two DevOps postings are a hands-on '10 years of expertise... expert in Jenkins, Terraform, and AWS' IC hire plus a Lead DevOps who will 'set the technical vision' — i.e. they are hiring the in-house owner full-time, which is precisely the role Ben's NOT-list excludes ('not a hands-on DevOps contractor', 'not a fractional CTO trying to own the technical vision').
